news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics CFO Louis Tamayo Sells 4,641 Shares
news.summary: CFO Louis Tamayo sold 4,641 shares at a weighted-average price of $4.49 on July 1, 2026, to cover tax withholding on RSUs that vested on June 29; CEO Nolan Townsend made a similar tax-related sale of 25,947 shares at $4.48. These were routine equity-compensation transactions tied to RSU vesting, not open-market conviction sales.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics CEO Logs RSU Grant and Tax-Driven Share Sale
news.summary: CEO Nolan Townsend was granted 67,000 shares of common stock as a compensation award; CFO Louis Tamayo received a smaller 12,000-share award the same day.

news.headline: JPMorgan Lowers Lexeo Therapeutics Price Target to $9 from $12, Keeps Overweight
news.summary: JPMorgan cut its price target on LXEO to $9 from $12 while reiterating an Overweight rating, citing an updated valuation model reflecting the company's latest pipeline developments.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Details 2026 Virtual Annual Meeting, Board Elections and Pay
news.summary: Lexeo held its fully virtual 2026 annual stockholders meeting, where shareholders voted to elect three Class III directors to terms running through 2029 and ratified KPMG LLP as independent auditor.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Announces Publication in JAMA Cardiology of Phase I/II Data for LX2006 in Friedreich Ataxia
news.summary: Peer-reviewed Phase I/II data on 17 Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy patients treated with LX2006 showed sustained cardiac and neurologic improvements, favorable biomarker changes, and a generally well-tolerated safety profile, reinforcing the clinical rationale for the pivotal program.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Announces Regulatory Update and Registrational Trial Design for LX2006 Gene Therapy in Friedreich Ataxia
news.summary: Lexeo finalized with the FDA the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial protocol and statistical analysis plan for LX2006, targeting a BLA submission under the accelerated approval pathway in H1 2028; enrollment was set to begin by end of June 2026 and shares jumped nearly 13% on the news.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Lexeo is expected to report second-quarter 2026 financial results and pipeline updates in August 2026; an exact date has not yet been announced.

catalysts.label: LX2020 12-month high-dose data (HEROIC-PKP2)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for a 12-month data update covering all high-dose PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy participants in the ongoing HEROIC-PKP2 Phase I/II trial.

catalysts.label: SUNRISE-FA2 topline data readout
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial of LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy is guided for the second half of 2027.

catalysts.label: LX2006 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Lexeo plans to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA for LX2006 under the accelerated approval pathway in the first half of 2028.

pulse: Lexeo remains a clinical-stage cardiovascular gene therapy company advancing two lead AAV programs, LX2006 for Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy and LX2020 for PKP2-related arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, with the FDA-aligned SUNRISE-FA2 pivotal trial design finalized in mid-June 2026 sending shares sharply higher, followed by supportive LX2006 data published in JAMA Cardiology and enrollment of the pivotal study underway. Despite this clinical and regulatory progress, JPMorgan trimmed its price target to $9 from $12 on June 25 even while keeping an Overweight rating, and the stock has since traded rangebound in the mid-single digits (roughly $4.50-$5.50) through late July with no major fresh catalysts beyond routine insider RSU-related transactions. Near-term catalysts to watch are Q2 2026 earnings expected in August, 12-month high-dose LX2020 data anticipated in Q4 2026, and SUNRISE-FA2 topline data expected in the second half of 2027 ahead of a planned 2028 BLA filing.
